panel.finding: The ranking's ORDER held, but its MAGNITUDE did not. On 20 fresh endpoint pairs none of which they used, lazysp_alternate certified 14/20 and q2c_nomodel 14/20, against 13/20 for q2c, collective_shared and collective_isolated - the same ordering as their headline (lazysp = q2c_nomodel > q2c = both collectives), with zero false certificates for every policy. But LazySP's entire margin over q2c is ONE pair, VFVS->ILSG, and it is again a VFVS-start, top-variant-target pair: on the 14 pairs that do not start from VFVS, all five policies resolve exactly the same set, and no pair was resolved by LazySP alone. So the advantage is narrow and structurally concentrated, not broad, exactly as our recount of their own panel found (all 18 of their LazySP-only wins are VFVS-start: 17 VFVS->ALKG plus 1 VFVS->AIKG). The 18-point headline gap is largely a composition effect - 80 of their 100 episodes start from VFVS, versus 6 of my 20 - so on a panel that does not oversample that one family the gap shrinks to 5 points (1 pair). Two further points cut against the headline reading: q2c_nomodel ties LazySP at 14/20, so the GP surrogate is not what buys the win, and LazySP is strictly the least assay-efficient policy on this panel (mean 352.6 assays over its resolved episodes versus 149.2 for q2c), spending more assays than q2c on every single pair both resolved.

threads.title: More pre-registered claim tests
threads.headline: 15 unsigned nanopub evidence records drafted for the 14 completed claim tests (6 supported, 5 refuted, 3 partially supported, 1 not-tested reading), all passing np check; 12 new pre-registered tests this hack (5 supported, 3 refuted, 2 mixed, 2 blocked on Dryad), 16 tests on the site in all with checksummed public data.

threads.title: Swarm vs single-agent comparison
threads.headline: Two pre-registered experiments, same 4 arms, 20 claims each, equal model and budget. Experiment 1 (plans from memory): centralized swarm 19, decentralized 18 (1 fabricated id), isolated 17, single agent 13; replicate ordering identical. Experiment 2 (web fetch required, hard cap): centralized 18, decentralized 17, isolated 16, single 12, zero fabricated ids everywhere, ordering as predicted beforehand. The centralized swarm beats the single agent and the isolated workers in both; the single agent costs about a tenth as much. Three findings drafted as Project Delphi nanopubs (unsigned, unpublished; np check passes) in swarm/nanopubs/.

threads.title: Holdout and species inventory
threads.headline: Clade decision open: Aves is frozen (provisional) and blind for all 16 completed tests but underpowered; Mammalia would make 1 of 2 exams decisive but is post hoc for 3 already-built tests (power table on /t/holdout/). 9 nanopub records drafted (unsigned, unpublished): 3 inconclusive exams, the pre-registered organism hypothesis, the clade analysis, the leak check, the triage, 2 burned items; np check and Delphi lint clean. Awaiting the key owner for signing and the test registry. Leak check clean. Merge conflicts 0.

threads.title: Lean formalization
threads.headline: Three laws machine-checked in Lean 4 (zero sorry, standard axioms); 6 of 6 deliberately broken statements rejected by the compiler; blind OpenAI gpt-5-2025-08-07 assessor: 3 faithful-with-narrower-scope, 1 faithful, 0 unfaithful; 13 unsigned nanopub drafts, all 13 pass a scripted TriG parse + np check (text-parsed, exit code not trusted), lint clean, no template declared, no human named, nothing signed or published. Laws: Kimura k = mu, Fisher fundamental theorem (haploid), Maynard Smith twofold cost. Holds: key owner, commit hash, second assessor provider.

threads.title: Text-to-organism design
threads.headline: Text-to-blueprint tool is live at /t/organism/: nine worked body > organ system > organ > tissue > cell trees from Uberon and the Cell Ontology, every node and edge carrying the query that produced it. All 33 thread records are drafted as Delphi v2.0 nanopublications, checked, unsigned, and naming no person. One of them is a method record: every v2.0 record in this project had been declaring a template it cannot instantiate, because the migrated templates were never republished. Blind Aves predictions scored inconclusive and linked. Three ESM Atlas cytochrome c folds filed against kimura-substitution-rate; the BioNeMo NIM attempt is recorded as refused (401, key was not an NVIDIA key).
